prompts.title: Slow Cinematic Push-In on Match Scene
prompts.prompt: Using the input image as the reference, animate a slow cinematic push-in over 6 seconds in vertical 9:16. The camera glides steadily forward toward the central action, adding subtle handheld breathing so the frame feels alive yet controlled. Keep all kits, colours, flags, crests and faces faithful to the input image, preserving the football setting and its referential illustrative nature. Where the image supports it, allow plausible, restrained movement: a ball rolling, players shifting weight, fabric stirring. Maintain stable anatomy, legible faces and consistent original identities; invent nothing beyond the frame. Leave the lower portion of the frame calm and uncluttered for subtitles. No on-screen text, narration or music; the downstream edit supplies audio.

prompts.title: Lateral Tracking Move Across the Pitch
prompts.prompt: Using the input image as the reference, animate a smooth lateral camera tracking shot lasting 6 seconds in vertical 9:16. The camera glides sideways across the scene with restrained parallax, foreground and background separating gently to give depth while keeping the composition steady. Faithfully preserve kits, colours, flags, crests, faces and the football setting, honouring the referential illustrative nature of the input image. Animate only what the image supports: physically coherent player motion, a ball moving along a believable arc, subtle crowd or turf response. Keep anatomy stable and faces legible, with original people intact and no invented figures or events. Keep the lower frame open for subtitles. No generated text, narration or music; audio is added downstream.
